verdict.rationale: Helicone provides a REST API for querying/exporting requests, one-line export to PostHog, and a self-hostable open-source deployment, which together support data portability and leaving the platform. However there's no explicit bulk 'export all my data' feature or documented open-format (CSV/JSON) dump, and a community comment disputes Helicone's 'open source' framing due to its Commons Clause license, undercutting the openness claim. Missing for 10: a dedicated full-account data export tool/format, and resolution of the open-source licensing dispute.
